correctness.rationale: Direct Hermitian projector proof: planar differences imply q mutually unbiased flat bases; centered projectors for distinct bases are Hilbert-Schmidt orthogonal, each block rank q-1, so their span is all constant-diagonal Hermitian matrices of dimension q²-q+1. The kernel is exactly traceless diagonal. Equality of rank-one measurements forces matched offdiagonal products and trace; pairwise products classify all supports, and every nonzero diagonal rank≤2 difference is a two-site signed diagonal. Supplemental ww* kills all such differences iff its squared coordinate magnitudes are pairwise unequal. Rank adds one. Sorting squared magnitudes gives sharp spacing ≤2/[q(q−1)] with unique equality profile. Explicit independent computations verified MUBs for q=5,7,11,25; Hermitian ranks for q=5,7,11; and representative fibers, criterion and contrast. Finite tests are corroboration, not general proof.

value.rationale: Determines all nonlinear ambiguity fibers for a natural infinite family of q mutually unbiased Gabor measurement bases, supplies the exact least count (one) and necessary-and-sufficient design criterion restoring universal phase retrieval even at sparse coordinate impulses, and finds the sharp unit-energy worst-impulse contrast profile. The q²−q+2 vs q² lifting-rank gap explains a concrete qualitative distinction between pure-state recovery and linear matrix tomography. The result does not purport to be a sharp noisy inverse stability theorem.
